Title: Murky Patch
Subtitle: Technical Alpha patch 0.2.5.30414 (May 22, 2014, article 14227686) adding playable Hero Murky alongside Rejoin, Inactive Player Removal, Matchmaking composition rules, Quick Cast, UI overhaul, Cursed Hollow Curse changes, level cap increase to 30, mount speed increase to 40%, major hero/talent updates, and bug fixes.
Highlights: Technical Alpha patch 0.2.5.30414 (May 22, 2014, article 14227686) adding playable Hero Murky alongside Rejoin, Inactive Player Removal, Matchmaking composition rules, Quick Cast, UI overhaul, Cursed Hollow Curse changes, level cap increase to 30, mount speed increase to 40%, major hero/talent updates, and bug fixes.
CleanedNotes:
=== General ===
[Updates]
  • Terrain Textures on Low graphic settings have received several improvements.
  • Rejoin Game: Early rejoin functionality implemented when disconnecting or closing the client while a game is still in progress.
  • Inactive Player Removal: Early inactivity system added; players with no game command for 150 seconds receive a warning, and those with no command within 30 seconds of the warning are dropped to the login screen with AI taking over and no XP, quest credit, or rewards earned if not rejoined before match end.
  • Matchmaking: Team composition rules added to encourage well-rounded teams (max 3 Warriors, 4 Assassins, 2 Support, 2 Specialists, 3 Melee heroes; full parties exempt, partial parties allowed with restrictions, and rules may relax after 6 minutes in queue).
  • Quick Cast: Added to Gameplay Options with Off (default), On, and On Release settings.
  • In-Game UI Overhaul:
  • - General: Added in-game timer at top center; moved team levels and Palace Health bars to top center (both Palace Health bars display once either takes damage); moved Health and Resource bars right of Hero Portrait; moved Battleground objective counters to bottom right below minimap; enlarged minimaps and removed borders; stacked death timer portraits with mouseover expansion; removed target panels and Battleground help pop-ups; removed Solo Kills from end-of-game Score Screen.
  • - Ability Buttons & Talent Selection: Improved standard ability buttons, placed activated Talent buttons above standard abilities, improved new Talent notification, made Hero Portrait clickable for Talent selection, and added Quick Talent selector via Ctrl and Ctrl + 1–5.
  • - Cursor: Added target-type/color changes (allied, enemy, untargetable) and distinct cursors for attack and ability commands.
  • Social Features:
  • - Character Portraits: Added portrait selection from the profile screen (top right portrait -> Change Portrait).
  • - Parties: Moved party panel to top right with character portraits; moved menu button to bottom right next to Friends List; removed party panel during Hero Select (access via right-clicking a hero); detailed Play with a Friend bonus in profile tooltips; added ability to request party invitations.
  • - Looking for Party Panel: Added to home screen and Friends List, displaying players looking for parties and parties seeking members, with a star next to players of similar skill.
  • - Friends List: Added broadcast message box at top, current activity status, and party status on hover.
  • - Chat: Chat windows disappear instantly while individual lines fade over time; non-text areas behind the chat window can be clicked.
  • - New User Help Tips: Added Uther pop-up tips with a close (X) button.
  • Sound: Complete voiceover kits added for all Heroes; Battleground characters received new voiceover replacing the default announcer; added over 35 minutes of live recorded music across Battlegrounds; added sound effects for recent Heroes and updated UI sound effects.
  • Shop: Added Murky; added Grunty Murky and Storm Lord Falstad skins; removed all prior Bundles and added Grunty Murky, Kaijo Diablo, Medic Uther, Prince Arthas, Tyrael Elite, and Zeratul Elite Bundles.
  • Snowballing & Gameplay: Added anti-snowballing adjustments for teams down 3+ levels; increased team level cap from 25 to 30; increased mount speed from 20% to 40% and removed per-level mount speed scaling; attack orders are no longer cleared after most abilities; added Alt + number self-cast for activated Talents; added underfoot Hero rings; added mana restoration previews on mana bars (such as Malfurion's Innervate).
  • Battlegrounds: Grave Golem root now prioritizes MULEs; Knight Mercenary Camp respawn time increased from 240s to 270s; Dragon Knight scales more aggressively over time; Haunted Mines jungle layout, mercenary camp locations, and two jungle Watch Towers updated, and skeletons/golem no longer auto-acquire until engaged.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Clicking "Reset Heroic" in Try Mode no longer reverts the selected hero skin to default.
  • Corrected a number of typos across multiple aspects of the game.
  • Fixed an issue that could cause performance spikes related to sound loading and playback.
  • Made improvements to help with certain Out Of Memory errors.
  • Combat sounds and effects are no longer audible or visible through the Fog of War.
  • Dragon Shire Mercenary Camp respawn timers are no longer drastically reduced when the Dragon Knight expires.
  • Fixed an issue on Dragon Shire causing Brightwing to clip into terrain after being punted by Dragon Knight's Savage Charge.
  • Heroes no longer attempt to path through enemy Gates on long-distance move commands toward opposite-side objectives.
  • Pings on the Dragon Knight no longer cause heroes to refer to it as a Mercenary Camp.
  • Northwest Knight Mercenary Camp on Blackheart's Bay now properly displays difficulty and description banner text.
  • Ability targeting reticules now cancel immediately upon a hero's death.
  • Corrected an issue causing purchased items to become unusable in-game.
  • Fixed an issue causing players to enter a locked state while navigating menus.
  • Friends List no longer becomes stuck when using mouse wheel scroll.
  • In-game Menu button mouseover tooltip no longer always displays 0 framerate.
  • Witch Doctor's Hero Select icon now displays an appropriate mouseover tooltip.

=== Talents ===
[Updates]
  • Calldown: MULE: Changed from target structure to target point; repairs closest structure and seeks another structure if full health is reached.
  • Cleanse: Cooldown reduced from 60s to 30s.
  • Demolitionist: Also increases basic attack damage to structures by 10%.
  • Executioner: Damage bonus reduced from 50% to 40%.
  • Focused Attack: Base cooldown increased from 5s to 10s; each basic attack reduces cooldown by 1s.
  • Path of the Warrior: Health gain per level increased from 25 to 35.
  • Path of the Wizard: Mana regeneration per level reduced from 0.2 to 0.1.
  • Promote: Now stores up to 2 charges.
  • Swift Storm: Removed Hearthstone cast time reduction; taking damage no longer dismounts the hero.

=== Battlegrounds: Cursed Hollow ===
[Updates]
  • Curse no longer reduces building health by 50% while active to reduce snowballing.

=== Heroes: Abathur ===
[Updates]
  • Symbiote:
  • - Stab: Base damage reduced from 50 to 40; damage gain per level increased from 10 to 13.
  • - Spike Burst: Base damage reduced from 32 to 28; damage gain per level increased from 10 to 12.
  • - Carapace: Base shield amount reduced from 160 to 140; shield gain per level increased from 14 to 16.
  • - Toxic Nest: Base damage reduced from 40 to 35; damage gain per level increased from 12 to 15.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Properly earns Takedown credit while using Symbiote on an ally near enemy hero deaths.
  • Can no longer hold a Dragon Shire objective point from his prior location before casting Ultimate Evolution.
  • Placing Toxic Nests in the enemy safe zone no longer causes intermittent game freezes.
  • Camera no longer snaps to Abathur after a cloned Witch Doctor's Ravenous Spirit expires with Camera Lock enabled.

=== Heroes: Arthas ===
[Updates]
  • Frostmourne Hungers (Trait): Reworked to be activatable so the next basic attack deals 100% increased damage and restores 30 mana; supporting Talents reworked.
  • Frost Strike (Q) & supporting Talents: Removed.
  • Death Coil (New Q): Targeted medium-range ability dealing damage to enemies or healing Arthas if cast on himself.
  • - Death Touch (Level 1 Talent): Death Coil instantly kills minions.
  • - Embrace Death (Level 16 Talent): Death Coil deals 20% more damage per 10% missing Health.
  • - Immortal Coil (Level 16 Talent): Death Coil always heals Arthas, with healing increased by 50% when self-cast.
  • Frozen Tempest: Now applies a stacking 6% per second movement speed slow up to 5 stacks (Remorseless Winter Talent removed); mana cost per second increased from 8 to 10; Biting Cold moved from level 16 to level 13.
  • Army of the Dead: Cooldown increased from 80 to 90 seconds.
  • Sindragosa: Cooldown reduced from 100 to 90 seconds; search width increased from 5 to 8; damage per level increased from 10 to 15.
  • Rune Tap (Talent): Health restore reduced from 8% to 6%.

=== Heroes: Brightwing ===
[Updates]
  • Arcane Flare: Base damage (inner/outer) reduced from 90/45 to 70/35; damage gain per level (inner/outer) reduced from 24/12 to 18/9.
  • Arcane Precision (Talent): Damage bonus reduced from 50% to 33%.

=== Heroes: Falstad ===
[Updates]
  • Fly: Now displays a landing spot indicator visible to all players.

=== Heroes: Gazlowe ===
[Updates]
  • Deth Lazor:
  • - Goblin Fusion (Level 16 Talent): Adds a 4th stage with stage 3 range and 50% additional damage.
  • Xplodium Charge:
  • - Extra TNT (Level 1 Talent): Deals 10% more damage per enemy hit, capped at 100%.

=== Heroes: Illidan ===
[Updates]
  • Attack Speed: Flat 0.6 attack speed with no per-level scaling.
  • Kit Overhaul: Removed Mark of Azzinoth (Trait), Betrayer's Strike (Q), Crescent Sweep (W), Lunge (E), and supporting Talents.
  • Betrayer's Thirst (New Trait): Basic attacks reduce ability cooldowns by 1 second and heal for 20% of damage dealt.
  • - Spar for Blood (Level 1 Talent): Basic attack healing increased to 30% of damage dealt.
  • - Ultimate Duelist (Level 7 Talent): Activatable (25s cooldown) to double basic attack cooldown reduction for 5 seconds.
  • Dive (New Q): Dives toward target enemy, dealing damage on impact and flipping over the target.
  • - Marked for Death (Level 4 Talent): Next basic attack on the Dive target deals 100% additional damage.
  • - Rapid Chase (Level 7 Talent): Grants 20% movement speed for 2 seconds after casting Dive.
  • - Betrayer's Ally (Level 13 Talent): Allows Dive to be cast on allies.
  • - Lunge (Level 13 Talent): Increases Dive cast range by 30%.
  • Sweeping Strike (New W): Dashes to target location damaging enemies in path; hitting an enemy grants 25% increased basic attack damage for 4 seconds.
  • - Battered Assault (Level 1 Talent): Increases basic attack damage bonus from 25% to 40%.
  • - Additional Reach (Level 4 Talent): Increases Sweeping Strike range by 20%.
  • - Immolation (Level 4 Talent): Burns nearby enemies for a few seconds after Sweeping Strike.
  • - Endless Bounds (Level 13 Talent): Ignores collision during Sweeping Strike.
  • - Second Sweep (Level 16 Talent): Stores up to 2 charges of Sweeping Strike.
  • Evasion (New E): Evades all basic attacks for 2 seconds.
  • - Demonic Life-Force (Level 1 Talent): Evasion also grants a 5-second shield.
  • - Lingering Evasion (Level 7 Talent): Grants 2 charges of Block (50% reduced basic attack damage) for 5 seconds after Evasion ends.
  • - Spell Evasion (Level 13 Talent): Reduces ability damage taken by 50% while Evasion is active.
  • Metamorphosis:
  • - Demonic Form (Level 20 Talent): Remains in Demonic Form until killed, allows mounting in Demonic Form, and increases Demonic Form attack speed bonus from 20% to 30%.
  • The Hunt: Cooldown increased from 45 to 60 seconds.
  • - Nowhere is Safe (Level 20 Talent): Makes cast range global and greatly increases acceleration.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Illidan clone created by Abathur's Ultimate Evolution now receives the proper Health bonus after casting Metamorphosis.

=== Heroes: Li Li ===
[Updates]
  • Healing Brew: Can now heal Li Li if she is the lowest-health target (does not refund mana).
  • Cloud Serpent: Cast time reduced from 0.5s to 0.25s; mana cost reduced from 65 to 40; cooldown reduced from 16s to 8s; duration reduced from 12s to 10s; base damage reduced from 22 to 20.
  • - Timeless Creature (Talent): Duration extension reduced from 100% to 50%.
  • Blinding Wind: Cast time removed.
  • Water Dragon: Now slows hit targets by 40% for 3 seconds; search radius increased from 9 to 12; base damage reduced from 310 to 260; damage gain per level reduced from 60 to 25.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Timeless Creature Talent now properly increases Cloud Serpent duration when cast on allied heroes.

=== Heroes: Muradin ===
[Updates]
  • Talent Rework: Significant Talent changes; Amplified Healing removed; Skullcracker moved from level 1 to 4; Third Wind moved from level 4 to 13.
  • Stormbolt: Mana cost reduced from 75 to 60.
  • - Infused Hammer (Talent): Mana refund increased from 50% to 75%.
  • - Sledgehammer (Talent): Damage to structures and minions increased from 200% to 400% and destroys 4 tower ammunition, but no longer stuns structures.
  • Thunderclap: Mana cost reduced from 60 to 50.
  • - Reverberation (Level 1 Talent): Slows enemy attack speeds by 33%.
  • - Healing Static (Level 13 Talent): Heals for 1% of Muradin's max Health per target hit.
  • - Thunderstrike (Level 13 Talent): Deals 300% damage if only one target is hit.
  • Dwarf Toss:
  • - Landing Momentum (Talent): Moved from level 4 to 7.
  • Haymaker: Knockback distance on secondary targets significantly increased.

=== Heroes: Murky ===
[Updates]
  • New Hero Released — Murky, Baby Murloc.

=== Heroes: Nazeebo ===
[Updates]
  • Death Ritual (Trait): Permanent Health/Mana gains per stack increased from 2/1 to 4/2.
  • Gargantuan: Now deals AoE damage when summoned and takes 50% reduced structure damage.
  • - Humongoid (Talent): Gargantuan lasts until killed.
  • Ravenous Souls: Movement speed increased by 10%.

=== Heroes: Nova ===
[Updates]
  • Talent Rework: Significant Talent changes.
  • Snipe:
  • - Ambush Snipe (Talent): 20% bonus damage while Cloaked now has a 1-second grace period.
  • - Railgun (Level 16 Talent): Snipe pierces enemies, dealing 50% damage to subsequent targets.
  • Holo Decoy:
  • - Extended Projection (Level 4 Talent): Increases cast range by 100%.
  • - Remote Access (Level 16 Talent): Allows controlling Holo Decoy and increases vision range from 6 to 12.
  • Follow Through (Level 7 Talent): After using an ability, the next basic attack deals 25% more damage.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Triple Tap visual effects no longer persist when the target dies before completion.
  • Triple Tap missiles no longer stop chasing targets that move far away after cast.

=== Heroes: Raynor ===
[Updates]
  • Health gain per level reduced from 140 to 120.
  • Penetrating Round:
  • - Bullseye (Talent): Now also deals 50% additional damage to the first target hit.
  • - Cluster Round (Talent): Increases search radius by 50%.
  • - Heavy Ammo (Talent): Structure damage increased from 50% to 100%.
  • Hyperion: Evenly distributes its four shots per volley across eligible targets instead of preferring structures; cooldown reduced from 120s to 100s; damage per shot per level increased from 5 to 6.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Banshees summoned by Raynor's Raiders no longer sit idle when cast while Raynor is attacking a target.

=== Heroes: Sgt. Hammer ===
[Updates]
  • Hotkeys & Talents: Swapped Siege Mode and Spider Mines hotkeys; significant Talent changes; removed Bribe, Have a Mine, and Maelstrom Rounds.
  • Artillery (Trait):
  • - First Strike (Level 13 Talent): Basic attacks deal 25% bonus damage if Sgt. Hammer has not taken damage in the last 5 seconds.
  • Thrusters:
  • - Hyper-Cooling Engines (Level 7 Talent): Auto-activates inside Hall of Storms without starting cooldown; reduces Thrusters cooldown from 30s to 20s.
  • Spider Mines:
  • - Slowing Mines (Talent): Slow duration increased from 1.5s to 2.5s; slow effect increased from 25% to 50%.
  • - Bullhead Mines (Level 13 Talent): Spider Mines knock back targets and stack if hit by multiple mines.
  • Siege Mode:
  • - Ambush (Level 1 Talent): Entering Siege Mode cloaks Sgt. Hammer; first basic attack from Siege Mode deals 50% bonus damage and breaks cloak.
  • - Resistant (Level 1 Talent): Reduces crowd control duration while in Siege Mode by 50%.
  • - Graduating Range (Level 16 Talent): Increases Siege Mode range by 1 every 3 seconds, up to +5.

=== Heroes: Stitches ===
[Updates]
  • Talents: Significant Talent changes; removed Bribe and Spell Shield.
  • Vile Gas (Trait):
  • - Vile Cleaver (Level 4 Talent): Basic attacks apply a non-stacking Vile Gas cloud to the target.
  • Hook:
  • - Helping Hand (Level 13 Talent): Can Hook allied heroes.
  • - Shish Kabob (Level 16 Talent): Hook can pull up to 2 targets.
  • Slam:
  • - Pulverize (Talent): Adds 50% Slam damage alongside the 0.5-second stun.
  • - Putrid Ground (Level 4 Talent): Slam infects targets with non-stacking Vile Gas.
  • Devour:
  • - Savor the Flavor (Level 7 Talent): Devouring an enemy hero permanently increases Health regeneration by 2 per second (stacking).
  • - Last Bite (Level 7 Talent): Reduces cooldown by 15 seconds if Devour kills the target.

=== Heroes: Tassadar ===
[Updates]
  • Base Health reduced from 800 to 750; Health gain per level reduced from 145 to 125.
  • Void Shift: Duration reduced from 2s to 1.5s.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Oracle now properly reveals cloaked enemy heroes.

=== Heroes: Tychus ===
[Updates]
  • Attack Speed: No longer gains attack speed per level; attack damage gain per level increased from 4 to 6.
  • Odin: Timed life increased from 18s to 23s; damage gain per level increased from 15 to 22.
  • Nuclear Strike: Range increased from 10 to 20.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Overkill no longer continues targeting or damaging enemies Tychus loses sight of (such as Tassadar using Void Shift or Abathur casting Ultimate Evolution).

=== Heroes: Tyrael ===
[Updates]
  • Archangel's Wrath (Trait): Reduces death timer by 20% per enemy hero hit by the explosion; supporting Talents reworked.
  • - Protection in Death (Level 1 Talent): Explosion grants nearby allies a shield absorbing up to 50% of max Health.
  • - Even in Death (Level 4 Talent): Allows casting non-heroic abilities during Archangel's Wrath without dealing damage.
  • El'Druin's Might:
  • - Blade of Justice (Level 16 Talent): Next 3 basic attacks after teleporting to the sword deal 100% more damage.
  • Righteousness: Reworked to temporarily shield Tyrael and nearby allies for a portion of the shield amount.
  • - Angelic Absorption (Level 4 Talent): Grants temporary Health regeneration when attacked while shielded.
  • - Reciprocate (Level 7 Talent): Shield explodes on expiration to damage nearby enemies.
  • - Salvation (Level 16 Talent): Increases Tyrael's shield amount by 25% per allied hero shielded.
  • - Zealotry (Level 7 Talent): Increases shield duration by 100%.
  • Smite (E): Replaced Hand of Sacrifice (and supporting Talents); deals damage in an arc and leaves an area that temporarily increases allied movement speed.
  • - Purge Evil (Level 1 Talent): Increases Smite damage to Heroes by 50%.
  • - Retribution (Level 4 Talent): Reduces cooldown by 0.5s per target hit.
  • - Angelic Might (Level 13 Talent): Increases next basic attack damage by 25% per target hit (up to 10 stacks).
  • - Cast Aside (Level 13 Talent): Pushes damaged enemies outside the target area.

=== Heroes: Tyrande ===
[Updates]
  • Hunter's Mark (Trait): Reworked to activate on a target enemy (excluding structures), revealing them and causing them to take 25% additional damage for 4 seconds (20s cooldown).
[Bug Fixes]
  • Lunar Flare no longer shares a cooldown with the Searing Arrows activated Talent.

=== Heroes: Uther ===
[Updates]
  • Talents: Significant Talent changes.
  • - Blessed Champion (Level 1 Talent): Basic attacks heal nearby allies for 25% of Uther's damage dealt.
  • - Hardened Focus (Level 13 Talent): Ability cooldowns recharge 50% faster while above 80% Health.
  • Holy Light:
  • - Protect the Weak (Talent): Cooldown and mana reduction on mercenaries and minions increased from 50% to 75%.
  • Holy Radiance:
  • - Wave of Light (Talent): Restores 10 mana and reduces cooldown by 1s per target healed, up to 50 mana and 5s.
  • Hammer of Justice: Base damage reduced from 50 to 40; damage gain per level reduced from 10 to 8.
  • - Divine Hammer (Level 7 Talent): Knocks the target back.
  • Divine Shield: Cooldown reduced from 120s to 90s.
[Bug Fixes]
  • AI heroes now respond more appropriately to an enemy Uther in Eternal Devotion form.

=== Heroes: Valla ===
[Updates]
  • Attack Speed: Flat 0.6 attack speed with no per-level scaling; base attack damage reduced from 64 to 28 and damage gain per level changed to +9.
  • Hatred (Trait): Now grants 2% bonus attack damage per stack instead of attack speed.
  • Strafe: Now grants 10 stacks of Hatred on activation.
